responsibility: This file defines the VR4130 family DFA pipeline model and the scheduling classifications used to cope with its unusual aligned-pair issue rules. Besides describing ALU, cache, and multiply/divide resources, reservations, and bypasses, it introduces the vr4130_class attribute used by scheduler hooks and supports the target-specific end-of-compilation alignment strategy that inserts nops to preserve profitable dual-issue pairings, making it the central scheduling description for r4130 tuning.
